mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.sports_meeting_id, r.event_id, r.participant_id, r.score, r.create_time, r.update_time, p.name AS participant_name, e.name AS event_name FROM result r LEFT JOIN participant p ON r.participant_id = p.id LEFT JOIN event e ON r.event_id = e.id WHERE r.sports_meeting_id = #{sportsMeetingId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT r.id, r.sports_meeting_id, r.event_id, r.participant_id, r.score, r.create_time, r.update_time, p.name AS participant_name, e.name AS event_name FROM result r LEFT JOIN participant p ON r.participant_id = p.id LEFT JOIN event e ON r.event_id = e.id WHERE r.event_id = #{eventId} ORDER BY r.score ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO result (sports_meeting_id, event_id, participant_id, score) VALUES (#{sportsMeetingId}, #{eventId}, #{participantId}, #{score})
